title: Flow Decomposition, Green Testing, and Lane--Emden Inequalities on Weighted Graphs
summary: We study positive solutions of the superlinear Lane--Emden inequality \[ -Δu\ge σu^q,\qquad q>1, \] on infinite locally finite weighted graphs and connected domains. When the Dirichlet Green function is finite, the existence of a positive solution is equivalent to \[ G_Ω\bigl(σg_Ω(o,\cdot)^q\bigr)(x) \le C g_Ω(o,x) \] for some pole \(o\inΩ\). Under Green function estimates, this yields sharp existence criteria and the Serrin-type exponents on \(\mathbb Z^d\) and orthant domains.
